FN-5VJ4R66-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 145
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/09/2026
Senate Bill 145 as introduced would remove the expiration date of September 30, 2028 from the
Medicaid assessment of private hospitals. Receipts from the hospital assessment are deposited
into the Alabama Health Care Trust Fund to be used by the Medicaid Agency to pay state match
for inpatient and outpatient services for Medicaid recipients throughout the state. In fiscal year
2025, the total revenue received from the hospital assessment, prior to deducting the costs of
collection, was approximately $280 million. The Alabama Medicaid Agency estimates $298
million to be collected for fiscal year 2026 from this hospital assessment.
